description: Background job: find the nearest exposed blocks of the given types, walk to them, pick the best hotbar tool, mine them and pick up the drops, until `count` are broken. When none are exposed, tunnels to buried ones up to 16 blocks away (dig: false turns that off). Refuses blocks your tools cannot harvest.

dig.description: Tunnel to buried blocks and dig on the way.

waitSeconds.description: Block up to this many seconds for the job to finish before returning (default 0: return at once).

name: collect_blocks
title: Collect blocks (job)
